name: awml
description: Describe, check and draw agentic workflows in AWML, the Agentic Workflow Modelling Language: who decides each step, who may see each part, and what needs a person's yes.

interface.shortDescription: Describe, check and draw agentic workflows
interface.longDescription: Use AWML to describe an agentic workflow with you, write it as two small YAML files, one for who may see each part and one for where each part runs, check them with awml check, and draw them as Mermaid. It then points out what the drawing reveals, such as content published to a wider audience without a yes. A second, optional skill publishes a workflow to an AWML registry when you ask it to.
defaultPrompt: Help me draw my AI workflow in AWML.
Check this AWML file and fix its mistakes.
